description: A plain Batch row that a killed tick left `running` with its batch id goes back to `submitted` at the head of the next Batch-poll sweep once its deadline plus the grace has passed, and that sweep polls it (batch 27 KTD9, AE6). Each core's grace constant equals `grace_ms`. With the clock at `now`, one tick with a Batch adapter whose poll returns the result leaves each row in `after`, and polls exactly the batches in `polled`. A job row is left to the job sweep, and a row with no batch id has no batch to poll. Read by packages/core-ts/test/stranded-batch-polls.test.ts and packages/core-py/tests/test_stranded_batch_polls.py.
